Example Bank Travel Card

Earn 5X miles on flights booked through Example Travel and 2X miles on all other purchases. The Travel Card is made for people who travel often and want their everyday spending to count toward the next trip.

Annual fee: $250. No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

Travel credit: up to $100 in statement credits each cardmember year for airline incidental fees. Enrollment required. Miles don't expire while your account is open, and you can transfer them to partner programs at the published ratios.

Miles are earned on eligible net purchases. Purchases that aren't eligible include balance transfers, cash advances, fees and interest. The category of a purchase depends on how the merchant is coded by the card network, and bookings through other travel sites earn the base rate.

Example Bank is a fictional bank used only in software tests. Nothing on this page describes a real card, a real account or a real offer, and none of it should be relied on for anything. This paragraph is here so the page has enough text to count as a real product page rather than a thin page that needs a browser.

Travel Card benefits include trip delay reimbursement and lost luggage coverage when you pay for the trip with your card. Coverage terms and limits are in the Guide to Benefits that comes with the card, and they can change with notice.

Authorized users earn miles for the primary cardmember at the same rates, at no extra cost, and their purchases appear on your monthly statement.
